services.name: Fall Fishing
services.desc: Here is breakdown of the species and types of fishing during the Spring, Summer, Fall and Winter months found in the inshore waters that surround Hilton Head Island. Cobia, Redfish, Trout, Spanish Mackerel, Tripletail, Sharks, and several other species. (main fish targeted are highlighted bold in red for the months listed) March-April: fishing inshore for Redfish, trout, black drum and sheepshead is excellent with redfish (2-12lbs) as the main target using light tackle spin and fly gear. Late April-May: Cobia (15-30+lbs) begin to arrive in the large numbers in the Calibougie and Port Royal Sounds. blurb: Off The Hook Fishing Charters offers fishing trips ranging from two to eight hours for individuals, families, corporate groups, and wedding parties. Trips are designed to be safe, productive, and enjoyable for all experience levels. They provide the right boats for inshore, nearshore, flats, fly or spin fishing.
